text_block_list.text:
I spotted King Halo shopping at the school 
store.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, wait? A hole puncher? I'm pretty 
sure I was looking for pudding...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I missed lunch, and now... Ugh, 
what am I even doing...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. ...It's not like I'm brooding 
over anything, though.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about how to scold the 
juniors who called in sick with a cold.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, neglecting your physical health 
is disgraceful for King's junior...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, now even I'm feeling 
totally out of sorts... *sigh*.

King Halo let out a heavy sigh, looking 
unusually downcast.
